crew.name: Maren
crew.line: You found my tools on the shoal? Then let's put them to work.

crew.name: Halvard
crew.line: Day 417. The coals were banked on purpose. I said someone would come.

crew.name: Brisa
crew.line: That still of yours whistles flat. I can fix that.

crew.name: Petch
crew.line: Silk holds if you tie it like you mean it.

crew.name: Suno
crew.line: Rain is just sky-sea. I speak both.

crew.name: Immel
crew.line: Half these gizmos were mine once, you know. The good halves.

crew.name: Reya
crew.line: Ditched at sea twice already. The third time buys the drinks.
